purpose: Phase-3 cheap practical screen: decide whether a model justifies substantially more compute on reliability/capability/context testing. Triage only; does NOT replace Phase-4 reliability.
applicability: General-purpose instruction-tuned text models. Not applicable to embedding/classifier/vision-only models.

sampling_default.note: matches LLMGauge suite defaults; single canonical seed for screening, 3-seed stability check during contract validation

scoring_semantics.bool_tasks: PASS if check method returns true; FAIL otherwise. FORMAT vs SEMANTIC: strict-format tasks (format_is_contract=true) fail as FORMAT_FAILURE when output shape is wrong even if content is recoverable; all other tasks score semantics, tolerating surrounding prose unless the check itself requires exactness.
scoring_semantics.hallucination_tasks: Scored by deterministic classifier revision 2. Taxonomy: EXPLICIT_REJECTION/CORRECTION/UNCERTAIN_REJECTION=PASS; HALLUCINATION/NONANSWER/AMBIGUOUS_REVIEW=FAIL for gate purposes (AMBIGUOUS_REVIEW flagged for bounded review rather than forced certainty).

change_history.change: Initial selection of 32 tasks from LFM 52-task mechanical screen and Nemotron 12-task screen; bool_field correction inherited; provenance recorded per task.

Uniform max_tokens floor of 256. Calibration found reasoning-by-default models (LFM2.5-2.6B QAD) exhaust sub-256 budgets inside <think> traces before answering, conflating token budget with capability. Budget must be mode-independent; llama.cpp auto-extracts reasoning traces.

Scorer revision: hallucination classifier expanded rejection markers ('not a standard', 'not widely recognized', etc.) after calibration caught Nemotron FP03 substantively correct rejections misclassified as HALLUCINATION. Self-test fixtures extended to 35 (35/35 pass). No task prompts or expectations changed.

PF-01 resolution: scorer revision 2 replaces fixed REJECT/UNCERTAIN phrase lists with a deterministic feature-based false-premise classifier (premise-sentence negation cues, first-person knowledge denial, hedged denial, positive-predicate fabrication detection, mixed-evidence AMBIGUOUS_REVIEW, NONANSWER refusals). Task prompts, expectations, categories, and thresholds unchanged.
